* Printed face: [[Owen Lars (Original)]]
|strategy=By [mailto:AndyLarkin@aol.com Andy Larkin]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20001010185041/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/owenlars.html</ref>

Owen and Beru go extremely well together, for a total power of 4, and deploy free at Lars Moisture Farm. What is also neat is Owen's ability of 3. Here's something cool- you can deploy at [[Tatooine]]: Lars Moisture Farm, Owen, maybe Beru, and a ton of Rebel Troopers, say, 6 or so, all for FREE, and have a huge power number.

You know what's even more incredible? Use [[CZ-3 (Seezee-Three){{!}}CZ-3]] and Don't Overestimate our Chances. That way, you can lure your opponent into a battle, deploy all the Troopers as a react, and use Don't Overestimate our Chances to triple the damage. Great way to get rid of high powered characters.
